label: Threshold
author: conky-studio
description: Compare a value to a threshold. Outputs 0/1, inverted 0/1, or passes the value when true (gate). Richer than the built-in Threshold Gate.

properties.label: Output
properties.help: binary → 1 when condition holds. gate → original value when true, else 0. invert_binary flips the 0/1.

properties.label: Equal ε
properties.help: Tolerance used only when Mode is Equal
